label: Bible Study
prompt: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of _____ there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
verse: As soon then as they were come to land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid thereon, and bread.
note: Breakfast on the beach — the risen Jesus already had the fire going.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a _____: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
verse: And it shall come to pass, that as ye were a curse among the heathen, O house of Judah, and house of Israel; so will I save you, and ye shall be a blessing: fear not, but let your hands be strong.
note: Once a curse among the nations, now a blessing — so fear not, and let your hands be strong.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the _____.
verse: Therefore they enquired of the LORD further, if the man should yet come thither. And the LORD answered, Behold, he hath hid himself among the stuff.
note: Israel's first king, on coronation day, hid himself 'among the stuff' — the KJV's word for baggage.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But _____ the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
verse: But speaking the truth in love, may grow up into him in all things, which is the head, even Christ:
note: Truth without love is a club; love without truth is a fog — Paul wants both, and growth follows.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a _____ shalt thou be in the earth.
verse: When thou tillest the ground, it shall not henceforth yield unto thee her strength; a fugitive and a vagabond shalt thou be in the earth.
note: Cain's sentence: 'a fugitive and a vagabond' — the ground that received Abel's blood would no longer yield to him.
